completion_data.completion_summary: Implemented centralized literature management: added LITERATURE_DIR env var with two-tier fallback to literature-retrieve.sh and skill-literature/SKILL.md, created ~/Projects/Literature/ with v2 index schema, migrated 183 BimodalLogic entries, configured env var in settings.json and home.nix, deployed updated scripts to BimodalLogic, and updated ROADMAP.md and extension documentation.

memory_candidates.content: jq -n --argjson passes JSON as command-line argument. When JSON exceeds ~128KB (OS limit), the error 'Argument list too long' occurs. Fix: use --slurpfile with temp files instead. Pattern: echo "$json" > tmpfile && jq -n --slurpfile var tmpfile '$var[0]'. Always use slurpfile for potentially large JSON arrays (e.g., literature indexes with 100+ entries).

The centralized literature repository at ~/Projects/Literature/ is the canonical source for all projects. LITERATURE_DIR=/home/benjamin/Projects/Literature is configured in .claude/settings.json (immediate effect in Claude Code) and ~/.dotfiles/home.nix (requires home-manager switch for shell sessions). The migration script at ~/Projects/Literature/scripts/migrate-from-repo.sh can import from additional per-project specs/literature/ directories.
